source_of_truth: Read by hand. app/components/ui/index.ts exports Card and CardHeader with `export { default as X } from './X.vue'` and a type-only `export type { CardProps }`; CardSkeleton.vue is not exported anywhere. Per the contract public = exported from the barrel, so Card and CardHeader are public and CardSkeleton is private. Card.vue starts with a multi-line HTML comment containing an @example (documented). CardHeader.vue has no comment, no @example and no sibling .md/.stories.* (undocumented, public → finding). CardSkeleton.vue is undocumented but private; the contract says private undocumented components are never a finding. None of the three is a library wrapper: Card's root is <section>, CardHeader's is <header>, CardSkeleton's is a <div> (the USkeleton is a child, not the root).

expected.rationale: exported from the barrel via `export { default as CardHeader }` and carries no documentation of any recognised form

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: not exported from index.ts, hence private; the contract states private undocumented components are never a finding
